An elderly man in his late seventies, approximately 170 cm tall, lean and slightly stooped, with weathered pale skin, hollow cheeks, a crooked nose, deep-set hazel eyes, an uneven gray beard, and wispy shoulder-length gray hair.

He wears a smoke-darkened charcoal traveling coat with an oversized asymmetrical hood, overlapping front panels, offset leather closures, a faded moss-green lining, and badly scorched hems and sleeves. Beneath it are a muted brown wool waistcoat and collarless taupe linen shirt. Narrow leather belts cross his waist at uneven heights, supporting several sealed pouches and compact unfamiliar instruments without identifying his trade.

His dark brown trousers are tucked into worn calf-high leather boots with rounded toes, old buckles, and repaired stitching. One wrist is enclosed by an aged brass support brace with small articulated joints and practical fastening straps.

He stands weakly beside burning airship wreckage inside a damaged industrial interior, one hand pressed to his ribs, his expression guarded and exhausted. His clothing is singed and soot-marked from the crash.
